title: Meta’s Muse reaches 10.2 million US downloads in 40 days
teaser: Meta’s Muse reached 10.2 million downloads in the United States during its first 40 days, a pace matched by only 11 other apps, according to Sensor Tower senior analyst Kara Lee. The latest app to hit that mark was Meta’s Threads, in July 2023. Muse’s early lead over ChatGPT, Claude and Grok is striking—but it comes with a major caveat: Muse is available only in the US and Canada, while ChatGPT’s launch reached several other countries.
